name: Himitsu no Pet Hatsujou Chuu
original_name: ヒミツの獣男子発情中
source:
When you return home rejected the evening after being broken up with by your boyfriend, waiting for you are four handsome men...who are actually your pets! Cue a fierce battle for the love of their beloved (former) owner -- you! But watch out for the reappearance of your ex...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/447180/My_Secret_Pets/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
和男友分手、懷著被甩的沮喪心情回到家時，等著你的卻是四名英俊男子……而他們其實是你的寵物！一場為爭奪心愛前任主人——也就是你——的激烈戀愛大戰就此展開。但要小心，你的前男友也重新出現了……

[來自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/447180/My_Secret_Pets/]Steam[/url]]
